description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_LegoMachine" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LegoMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Machine build started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildEntry" name="Subcomponent build entry">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsCheck" name="Container has parts?" default="Flow_8">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Test successful?" default="Flow_12">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign and rebuild subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllBuilt" name="All subcomponents built and tested?" default="Flow_16">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleMachine" name="Assemble subcomponents into machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineComplete" name="Machine completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildEntry" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildEntry" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_PartsCheck" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" name="No, container empty" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" name="Yes, parts available" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildEntry" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Gateway_AllBuilt" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_BuildEntry" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllBuilt" targetRef="Task_AssembleMachine" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="No, more subcomponents" sourceRef="Gateway_AllBuilt" targetRef="Gateway_BuildEntry" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_AssembleMachine" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineComplete" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
